label: J1 at the selected world, from J1 (inference)
rule: Instantiation: the support world of J1 is taken to be the selected world
meaning: J1 (every concrete supporter, at any carrier world, of a concretum necessary from w is necessary from w) gives its selected-world instance by taking the support world to be w. Registered as a strength order (J1 strengthens its instance); strictness is witnessed by Control.offWorldContingent. An instantiation, not a new derivation; no premise is established.
